fatal_step_selection.why: Held-out discrepancy controls stopping, but the method names calibration/development/test splits without binding this term. If it means test data, the final evaluation split has entered model selection.

likely_fatal_step.why: S6 stops on ambiguous 'held-out' data; if it means test, evaluation data guide model selection.

t1_audit.dataflow: S1->S7 is acyclic; each typed output is consumed only after production.
t1_audit.parameter_audit: W4/A8 are bit widths; alpha and preregistered B are named. B is estimated at 2–4 GPU-days. eta=.5 and action values are reviewer-chosen, not candidate parameters.

test_R .16->.01; unchanged second round stops; static PTQ .16 vs candidate .01; one-pass matches; test-driven stopping compromises independence.

estimand_match.declared: Reachable Q-policy observations with matched xi; normalized full-chunk squared action discrepancy to frozen BF16.
estimand_match.check: S5 estimates the same quantity over the recorded Dhat_Q sample; no quantity/conditioning mismatch established. Transfer to another split is empirical and needs that split to sample the intended evaluator population.
estimand_match.result: S5 matches on sampled Dhat_Q; no mismatch established. Cross-split transfer is empirical.

t1_audit.occupancy_common_state_caveat: BF16 is replayed at each observation sampled from D_Q(phi): this is common-state conditional action fidelity. It does not compare quantized/BF16 occupancy distributions, state transitions, executed-prefix commands, or task success.

formalized_procedure.note: Verbatim: 1. Freeze one released Fast-WAM checkpoint, inference mode, observation preprocessing, denoising schedule, LIBERO-Goal evaluator, controller, execution prefix, and calibration/development/test episode splits.

formalized_procedure.produces: fixed signed groupwise W4 tensors/scales; W4A8 schema; alpha[l,s,t] table schema
formalized_procedure.note: Verbatim: 2. Quantize every denoiser Linear projection (joint-attention Q/K/V/O, FFN/MoE, conditioning/AdaLN, and action projections) to signed groupwise W4 weights with zero point 0 and signed symmetric A8 activations with zero point 0. Keep W4 group scales fixed; define one A8 clipping limit alpha_{l,s,t} per target layer, stream, and denoising step.

formalized_procedure.produces: initial alpha table and W4A8 candidate phi_0
formalized_procedure.note: Verbatim: 3. Initialize alpha from ordinary static PTQ calibration on the available reference-policy histories, producing the W4A8 starting candidate; do not update any WAM weights.

Verbatim: 4. Run that candidate closed-loop on the calibration episodes under the frozen evaluator and record every pre-replan observation, model history/cache needed for inference, executed action history, and denoising seed. The environment produces D_Q(phi); controller and replanning rules remain unchanged.

formalized_procedure.consumes: recorded Q observations, quantized/BF16 checkpoint runs, matched xi and D_a
formalized_procedure.produces: paired full action chunks and empirical normalized squared L_act
formalized_procedure.note: Verbatim: 5. At each recorded observation, replay the candidate and BF16 checkpoint with matched denoising randomness, compare the full generated action chunks after the checkpoint's existing action normalization, and accumulate L_act(phi;D_Q(phi)).

formalized_procedure.consumes: alpha_t, current Q-history loss, named budget B and held-out discrepancy
formalized_procedure.produces: refit alpha_(t+1), refreshed Dhat_Q and stop/continue decision
formalized_procedure.note: Verbatim: 6. Update only alpha_{l,s,t} by minimizing the mean L_act on the collected Q-history observations; W4 weight scales, model parameters, bit allocation, and controller stay fixed. Re-run the quantized policy to refresh D_Q after each update, stopping when held-out action discrepancy ceases to improve or the preregistered pilot compute budget B is reached.

formalized_procedure.consumes: frozen final W4A8 quantizer, separate evaluation episodes and fixed evaluator
formalized_procedure.produces: own-history action discrepancy and separate success outcome
formalized_procedure.note: Verbatim: 7. Freeze the final W4A8 quantizer and evaluate it without BF16 teacher calls on separate LIBERO-Goal episodes; report action discrepancy on its own visited histories and closed-loop success as separate outcomes. No native speed claim is made until a WAM-compatible packed W4A8 kernel is measured.

negative_control.evidence: At alpha=.7, BF16-history gradient 1 with eta=.5 gives alpha=.2; dev_R rises 0->.25 and test_R .01->.16 (static baseline). If BF16/Q targets match, gradient is 0: movement is contingent.

dry_run.instance: S6 was selected as likely fatal before execution. One alpha, one normalized action coordinate D_a=1, BF16 action 0; alpha0=.2 (reference target .2); Q targets .7 for two rounds; dev=.7, test=.6; eta=.5. Outputs are synthetic loss inputs only; no model/simulator. Both held-out readings are run.

execution.script:
# Synthetic action-loss fixture; no model, backbone, simulator, or training.
# One alpha[l,s,t], one normalized action coordinate, BF16 teacher action = (0,).
eta, D_a = 0.5, 1.0
q_targets = (0.7, 0.7)       # stipulated outputs for current/refreshed Q histories
dev_target, test_target = 0.7, 0.6
bf16_history_target = 0.2
alpha_static = 0.2           # argmin of synthetic reference-history loss (alpha-0.2)^2
def loss(alpha, target): return ((alpha-target)/D_a)**2
def grad(alpha, target): return 2*(alpha-target)/(D_a*D_a)
def step(alpha, target): return alpha-eta*grad(alpha,target)
alpha = alpha_static
dev_prev, test_prev = loss(alpha,dev_target), loss(alpha,test_target)
print(f"fixture: alpha0={alpha:.2f}, eta={eta:.2f}, D_a={D_a:.1f}, Q_rows={len(q_targets)}, teacher=(0,)")
print(f"static_reference_PTQ: alpha={alpha:.2f}, dev_R={dev_prev:.6f}, test_R={test_prev:.6f}, ref_R={loss(alpha,bf16_history_target):.6f}")
one_pass = None
for r,target in enumerate(q_targets,1):
    before=alpha
    g=grad(before,target)
    alpha=step(before,target)
    dev_now,test_now=loss(alpha,dev_target),loss(alpha,test_target)
    print(f"Q_refit_round{r}: target={target:.2f}, alpha_before={before:.2f}, Q_loss_before={loss(before,target):.6f}, g_Q={g:.6f}, alpha_after={alpha:.2f}, Q_loss_after={loss(alpha,target):.6f}, dev_R={dev_now:.6f}, test_R={test_now:.6f}, dev_improved={dev_now<dev_prev}, test_improved={test_now<test_prev}")
    if r==1: one_pass=alpha
    dev_prev,test_prev=dev_now,test_now
last_dev_improved=loss(alpha,dev_target)<dev_prev
last_test_improved=loss(alpha,test_target)<test_prev
print(f"round2_stop: alpha={alpha:.2f}, no_dev_improvement={not last_dev_improved}, no_test_improvement={not last_test_improved}")
print(f"one_pass_declared_naive: alpha={one_pass:.2f}, dev_R={loss(one_pass,dev_target):.6f}, test_R={loss(one_pass,test_target):.6f}")
print(f"multi_round_candidate: alpha={alpha:.2f}, dev_R={loss(alpha,dev_target):.6f}, test_R={loss(alpha,test_target):.6f}, ref_R={loss(alpha,bf16_history_target):.6f}")
# T2b: replace Q-history gradient with the matched BF16-reference-history gradient.
before=alpha
g_ref=grad(before,bf16_history_target)
alpha_ctrl=step(before,bf16_history_target)
print(f"T2b_control: g_BF16={g_ref:.6f}, alpha={before:.2f}->{alpha_ctrl:.2f}, dev_R={loss(before,dev_target):.6f}->{loss(alpha_ctrl,dev_target):.6f}, test_R={loss(before,test_target):.6f}->{loss(alpha_ctrl,test_target):.6f}, static_test_R={loss(alpha_static,test_target):.6f}")
print(f"T5_static_naive: alpha={alpha_static:.2f}, test_R={loss(alpha_static,test_target):.6f}; candidate: alpha={before:.2f}, test_R={loss(before,test_target):.6f}; abs_gap={loss(alpha_static,test_target)-loss(before,test_target):.6f}")
# Perturbation: if BF16-history target equalled Q target, the control need not move R.
alpha_same=step(before,q_targets[-1])
print(f"control_same_target_perturbation: alpha={before:.2f}->{alpha_same:.2f}, test_R={loss(before,test_target):.6f}->{loss(alpha_same,test_target):.6f}, moved={loss(before,test_target)!=loss(alpha_same,test_target)}")
print(f"T3_single_loss={loss(0.2,0.7):.6f}, T3_identical_pair_mean={(loss(0.2,0.7)+loss(0.2,0.7))/2:.6f}, T3_tie_dev={loss(0.7,dev_target):.6f}->{loss(0.7,dev_target):.6f}")

claim_step_map.claim: Q rollouts define D_Q over visited observations; later terminal visits are censored.
S5 pairs full action chunks on the same observations, with matched xi and D_a.
Only A8 alpha changes; W4 scales, weights, controller, schedule and prefix stay fixed.
Refits refresh Q history; neither simulator nor WAM weights are differentiated/updated.
Deployment uses frozen alpha and ordinary W4A8 GEMM; teacher is calibration-only.
assumptions_missing: Compatible W4A8 GEMM and clip-table serialization are available on target.

The mechanism is an incremental DAgger-style quantizer application, not a general PTQ algorithm.
